in_marathi.name: Chintoo
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chintoo हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chin’ meaning thought and ‘tū’ meaning new or little. In Hindu mythology, Chintoo is a name given to the god Ganesha, the elephant-headed god of wisdom and intelligence.
